capabilities: Show a random prompt from a chosen vault file
Pick a prompt file in settings
Trigger prompts via a sidebar button, command, or hotkey
disambiguation: Not a prompt-engineering or AI tool; it only displays lines of text you store yourself.
extras: Prompts must be plain single-line text without Markdown formatting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to surface a random motivational or reflection prompt from your own notes.
summary: Random prompt viewer that shows an inspirational text prompt from a chosen file in your vault.
